mod.fireflymc.name: FireflyMC
fireflymc.configuration.title: FireflyMC Configuration
Adjust the size of the HUD interface, default 0.5
fireflymc.configuration.singleplayer_rel: Configure the singleplayer public lobby and P2P connection
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.enab: Enable the singleplayer public lobby prompt and LAN bridge preparation
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.prom: Show a prompt after entering a singleplayer world to ask whether to publish it
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.allo: Allow commands when opening the integrated server to LAN for relay hosting
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.max_: Maximum remote players allowed by the relay lobby
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.rela: WebSocket URL for FireflyMC singleplayer relay lobby
fireflymc.config.singleplayer_relay.p2p_: Try P2P UDP tunnel before falling back to the WebSocket relay
P2P connection timeout before falling back to relay
Minimum local UDP port for P2P endpoints, 0 means random port
Maximum local UDP port for P2P endpoints, 0 means random port
Reliable UDP retransmission interval in milliseconds
Reliable UDP sliding window size in packets
Try direct IPv6 connection first when both peers have public IPv6 addresses
fireflymc.configuration.ipv6_probe.enabl: Probe client IPv6 outbound connectivity via test-ipv6.com
fireflymc.configuration.ipv6_probe.auto_: Silently probe IPv6 outbound once when entering a singleplayer world
fireflymc.configuration.ipv6_probe.timeo: Timeout for a single IPv6 probe request
fireflymc.configuration.ipv6_probe.cache: How long a completed probe result is cached; 0 = never cache
fireflymc.configuration.event_notificati: Configure client-side local player event notification WebSocket
fireflymc.config.event_notification.enab: Send client-side local player event notifications over WebSocket
fireflymc.config.event_notification.web_: WebSocket server URL for client event notifications
fireflymc.config.event_notification.auto: Reconnect the event notification WebSocket after the connection closes
fireflymc.config.event_notification.reco: Delay before reconnecting the event notification WebSocket
fireflymc.config.event_notification.hear: Interval for sending event notification WebSocket heartbeat messages
fireflymc.config.event_notification.send: Timeout for sending event notification WebSocket messages
fireflymc.config.event_notification.queu: Maximum queued event notification messages while reconnecting
fireflymc.config.event_notification.cros: Forward in-game chat to QQ groups and vice versa (requires cross_chat_enabled on the server)
fireflymc.config.player_auth.enabled.too: Set password on first join, verify on subsequent joins
fireflymc.config.player_auth.lockout_min: Lock the client for this long after exhausting password attempts (0=disabled)
fireflymc.auth_lockout.title: Login Restricted
fireflymc.auth_lockout.message: Too many failed password attempts. Please try again in about %s minutes.
fireflymc.server_shutdown.title: Server Under Maintenance
fireflymc.server_shutdown.message: The server is under maintenance (pseudo-shutdown). Multiplayer and relay are temporarily disabled. Singleplayer / LAN / P2P are unaffected.
fireflymc.server_shutdown.announce: §c[FireflyMC]§r Server entered shutdown maintenance. Multiplayer and relay are disabled.
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.subtitle.available: Successfully connected to IPv6 probe service
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.subtitle.not_detected: Click the button below to start
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.gua.label: Local global IPv6
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.gua.hint: Does not imply public inbound reachability
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.hint.available: IPv6 outbound is available; public inbound and P2P direct connectivity are not yet verified.
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.hint.not_detected: No usable IPv6 outbound detected; the relay link is still used.
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.hint.probe_failed: IPv6 probe incomplete; the probe service may be unreachable. Hosting is unaffected.
gui.fireflymc.ipv6.hint.idle: This result only reflects IPv6 outbound capability, not public game-port reachability.
